# Seonjeong Park

> Design Engineer based in London, working at the intersection of AI and XR. Portfolio site with project case studies, experiments, and about/CV information.

Seonjeong Park works across research, design, and engineering to prototype, validate, and ship immersive experiences — from production VR/MR at NoGhost to AI-driven spatial storytelling and Snap Spectacles prototypes.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://harrietpark.github.io/): Introduction, recent experiments, selected work
- [About](https://harrietpark.github.io/about.html): Experience, skills, awards, publications, education, CV download
- [Work](https://harrietpark.github.io/project.html): Full project portfolio
- [Playground](https://harrietpark.github.io/playground.html): Experiments and prototypes
- [CV (PDF)](https://harrietpark.github.io/files/SeonjeongPark_CV.pdf): Downloadable resume

## Selected projects

- [Matterly](https://harrietpark.github.io/Matterly.html): Spatial AI learning on Snap Spectacles — scan everyday objects, reveal material lifecycles in AR, save to companion web object-dex. Finalist, Reality Hack at AWE 2026.
- [PinPoint](https://harrietpark.github.io/PinPoint.html): Multi-platform spatial computing system for contextual briefings via AR glasses. XRCC 2026 Runner-Up.
- [8pm and the Cat](https://harrietpark.github.io/8pmAndCat.html): 13-minute AI-driven VR film with personalised real-time narratives. Venice Immersive 2025, BFI Expanded 2025.
- [Public Speaking in VR Research](https://harrietpark.github.io/Presentation.html): VR app reducing foreign language anxiety, tested with 40+ participants. Published in Frontiers in Virtual Reality; IEEE VR 2023.
- [Baobab Diary](https://harrietpark.github.io/BaobabDiary.html): Mixed-reality mindfulness app with voice input and AI feedback. Winner, 2024 Korea Metaverse Developer Contest.
- [Semantic Highlight](https://harrietpark.github.io/SemanticHighlight.html): Highlight text in AR and pull out meaning with AI on Snap Spectacles.
- [Gaze to Voice](https://harrietpark.github.io/gazeToVoice.html): Real-time storytelling triggered by gaze in VR.
- [StyleShift](https://harrietpark.github.io/StyleShift.html): Live Stable Diffusion textures in Unity.

## Current role

XR Developer at [NoGhost](https://www.noghost.co.uk/) (Oct 2022 – present), London immersive studio. Shipped 6+ production VR/MR apps in Unity and Unreal for Meta Quest, Apple Vision Pro, and mobile.

## Skills (summary)

Spatial Computing: Unity, Unreal Engine, Lens Studio, Snap Spectacles, Apple Vision Pro, Meta Quest
AI: OpenAI, Gemini, Stable Diffusion, ComfyUI, Gaussian Splatting
Software Engineering: C#, C++, Python, TypeScript, React, Supabase
HCI & Prototyping: User Studies, Experimental Design, Research Prototyping, Statistical Analysis, Multimodal Interaction, Figma, Blender
